scenarios.title: A｜借物品
scenarios.setting: 在“向朋友借东西”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“借物品”。

turns.text: Hey, could I borrow something from you?

turns.prompt: 你想向朋友借用临时需要的物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you have a charger I could borrow?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a charger I could borrow?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Could I borrow your umbrella for the afternoon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could I borrow your umbrella for the afternoon?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: I forgot my headphones. Could I borrow yours for a little while?

feedback.naturalExpression: I forgot my headphones. Could I borrow yours for a little while?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Do you happen to have a power bank I could use?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you happen to have a power bank I could use?
feedback.explanation: “do you happen to”用来试探对方是否刚好有某物或知道某事，语气比较委婉。

choices.text: Can you borrow me your charger?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have a charger I could borrow?
feedback.explanation: “borrow”是借入，“lend”是借出；请对方借给自己，应该说“Could you lend me …?”。

turns.text: Yeah, you can use my charger.

turns.prompt: 关于「向朋友借东西」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks! I’ll give it back before I leave.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks! I’ll give it back before I leave.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: You’re a lifesaver. I’ll return it later today.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re a lifesaver. I’ll return it later today.
feedback.explanation: “lifesaver”在感谢时常指帮了大忙的人，不一定是真的救了命。

choices.text: Thanks. I only need it for about half an hour.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I only need it for about half an hour.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: B｜借钱
scenarios.setting: 玩家临时发现自己身上没带够钱。

turns.text: This is a little embarrassing, but could I borrow some money?
Sure. How much do you need?

turns.prompt: 你想请朋友暂时垫付，并说明归还打算，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you lend me twenty dollars? I’ll pay you back tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you lend me twenty dollars? I’ll pay you back tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’m twenty dollars short. Would you mind covering me for now?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m twenty dollars short. Would you mind covering me for now?
feedback.explanation: “Would you mind + 动词 -ing”礼貌请求对方做事，给对方表达不便的余地。

choices.text: Could you spot me twenty? I’ll pay you back later.

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you spot me twenty? I’ll pay you back later.
feedback.explanation: “spot me twenty”口语中表示先借我二十块；补上还款承诺让请求更清楚。

choices.text: I forgot my wallet. Could you cover this and I’ll pay you back?

feedback.naturalExpression: I forgot my wallet. Could you cover this and I’ll pay you back?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Can you borrow me twenty dollars?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you lend me twenty dollars? I’ll pay you back tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: 请对方借钱给自己用“lend me”；也可换主语，说“Could I borrow twenty dollars?”。

turns.prompt: 关于「向朋友借东西」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll send it back to you tonight.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll send it back to you tonight.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I really appreciate it. I’ll pay you back tomorrow.

feedback.naturalExpression: I really appreciate it. I’ll pay you back tomorrow.
feedback.explanation: “appreciate it”是简短感谢，“it”指对方刚提供的帮助。

choices.text: Thanks, I owe you one.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks, I owe you one.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

scenarios.title: C｜归还 / 延迟归还
scenarios.setting: 玩家之前向朋友借了一本书。

turns.text: Hey, here’s the book I borrowed from you.
Oh, thanks! Did you like it?

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yeah, I really enjoyed it. Thanks for lending it to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I really enjoyed it. Thanks for lending it to me.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: I did! I’m glad you recommended it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I did! I’m glad you recommended it.
feedback.explanation: “I'm glad”表达自己的积极感受，适合回应好消息或说明一件事对自己的意义。

choices.text: Yeah. Sorry I kept it for so long.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. Sorry I kept it for so long.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: Thanks for letting me borrow it.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for letting me borrow it.
feedback.explanation: 感谢后面说明具体原因，让对方知道哪项帮助对自己有用。

choices.text: Thanks for borrowing me the book.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I really enjoyed it. Thanks for lending it to me.
feedback.explanation: 对方是借出书的人，应用“lending”；感谢用“Thanks for lending me the book”。

turns.text: Hey, about the book I borrowed from you…

turns.prompt: 你想询问能否延长借用时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Would it be okay if I kept it for a few more days?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I kept it for a few more days?
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I’m not quite finished with it yet. Could I return it next week?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not quite finished with it yet. Could I return it next week?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

choices.text: Sorry, I thought I’d be done by now. Do you need it back soon?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sorry, I thought I’d be done by now. Do you need it back soon?
feedback.explanation: “I thought I’d”用较委婉的方式说明自己的打算，不一定是在纠正原先的理解。

choices.text: Would you mind if I returned it a little later than we planned?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you mind if I returned it a little later than we planned?
feedback.explanation: “would you mind if”征求对方对某个安排是否介意，后面接完整从句；与“mind + -ing”的结构不同。

choices.text: Can I return it more late?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would it be okay if I kept it for a few more days?
feedback.explanation: “early / late”的比较级是“earlier / later”，不用“more early / more late”；“later”前也不再加“more”。

turns.text: That’s fine. I’m not in a hurry to get it back.

turns.prompt: 关于「向朋友借东西」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks. I’ll definitely bring it back next week.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’ll definitely bring it back next week.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great, thanks. I’ll let you know when I’m finished.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great, thanks. I’ll let you know when I’m finished.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I appreciate it. I’ll take good care of it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate it. I’ll take good care of it.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。
